channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The 550 Terry A. Francois page called the building Class A office space. No source read uses that grade, so the description now says six-story office building.
item.description: The 550 Terry A. Francois page called the building Class A office space. No source read uses that grade, so the description now says six-story office building. Source: REBusiness Online, 2022-05-25 (rebusinessonline.com); SF Standard, 2024-09-20.

item.title: Correction · 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: 550 Terry François no longer says the building was 'subleased' to OpenAI. The San Francisco Standard calls it a lease of 350,000 sq ft, Hoodline a lease of 315,000, and The Real Deal a sublease with both figures; these differences are recorded.

item.title: Correction · 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The 550 Terry A. Francois notes now say that May 2022 is the date of the REBusinessOnline report that DivcoWest bought the building, not a sale date, and that the report names no seller. The building's earlier owner, Gap, is mentioned only in a Real Deal article that could not be opened, so it is unconfirmed.

item.title: Correction · 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The record's summary and map notes called 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard the longtime Gap Inc./Old Navy corporate headquarters. The Real Deal (2024) and REBusinessOnline (2022) say only that it once served as Old Navy's headquarters and that DivcoWest bought it from parent company Gap in 2022, so the summary now says that and cites both articles. The aerial photo credit now names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per that account's user page) and drops the 'departing flight' wording, which the file page does not state.
item.description: The record's summary and map notes called 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard the longtime Gap Inc./Old Navy corporate headquarters. The Real Deal (2024) and REBusinessOnline (2022) say only that it once served as Old Navy's headquarters and that DivcoWest bought it from parent company Gap in 2022, so the summary now says that and cites both articles. The aerial photo credit now names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per that account's user page) and drops the 'departing flight' wording, which the file page does not state.
